components_weak: Metrics - No specific quantification of business impact or revenue opportunity
Economic Buyer - Only primary contact identified, final decision maker unknown
Decision Process - Timeline and approval stages incomplete
Competition - No specific competing solutions identified
components_strong: Identified Pain - Clear capability gap articulated with supporting evidence
Champion - Nikola identified as technical champion with concrete action item
Decision Criteria - Technical requirements well-documented with specific Next.js and SDK requirements
proposed_instruction: When carrying forward cumulative MEDDICC state to a new analysis, explicitly acknowledge the starting point. For first calls (cumulative state all unknown), note this in the preamble so the analysis team understands this is baseline discovery, not a regression. Use language like 'First call - all MEDDICC components are at discovery stage' to frame expectations appropriately.
